title: I. Question. What must a man doe, that he may come into Gods fauor, and be saued?

segments.text: FOR answer to this Question, some Groundes must be laid downe beforehand. The first is this; That we must consider and remember, how and by what meanes, God brings any man to saluation. For looke how God saueth others; so he that would know how to be saued, must vse the meanes whereby God saueth them.
